out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: IN DRY STORAGE: OBSERVED A PACKAGE OF WAX GOURD PASTE TO BE COMPLETELY MOLDY INSIDE. IN DRY STORAGE: OBSERVED A PACKAGE OF PURE WHITE LOTUS PASTE TO BE RIPPED OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CDI: ITEMS DISPOSED OF. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW TOMATO AND LETTUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND CHICKEN MOVED TO LOWER SHELF.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (1): RED BEAN CAKE AT 67F, DURIAN CAKE AT 66F, TAROT CAKE AT 66F, EGG CAKE AT 67F. ALL ITEMS WERE IN OVERNIGHT. OBSERVED IN (2) TIRAMISU AT 53F, AND EGG TART AT 53F. ITEMS WERE IN COOLER OVERNIGHT. OBSERVED ON THE COUNTER: VARIOUS BREADS/BUNS MADE WITH DAIRY AND EGG AT 61-63F. FOOD WAS ON COUNTER OVERNIGHT. OBSERVED ON COUNTER IN BACK BAKING AREA: RAW POOLED EGGS AT 63F. ITEMS WERE ON COUNTER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ALL TCS ITEMS IN (1) AND (2) WERE DISPOSED OF. ALL TCS ITEMS FOUND ON THE COUNTER AND LEFT OVERNIGHT WERE DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED TO GO CONTAINERS STORED IN BULK DRY FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. REPLACE ALL TO GO CONTAINERS WITH SCOOPS WITH HANDLES POINTED UPWARDS BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR DISPLAY COOLER (RIGHT) TO NOT BE FUNCTIONAL AND HOLDING FOOD AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. OBSERVED TWO-DOOR DISPLAY COOLER (LEFT) TO BE AT 50F AND HOLDING FOOD ~53.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: EQUIPMENT TAKEN OUT OF USE DURING INSPECTION. NO TCS ITEMS TO BE STORED IN THESE COOLERS UNLESS THEY ARE OPERATIONAL.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ON DISPLAY COUNTER: RICE AND PORK IN BAMBOO LEAF 69F (1HR) IN NON-OPERATIONAL DISPLAY COOLER (1): PASTRIES WITH MEAT, CHEESE, EGG: 69-70F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC STATED ITEMS WERE ONLY PLACED ON COUNTER AND IN NON OPERATIONAL COOLER AN HOUR EARLIER. TCS ITEMS PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: EGG TARTS USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL, BUT WERE NOT MARKED WITH TIME.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: TIME MARKED.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED OPEN FOOD AND DRINKS STORED ON TOP OF A BAKING SHEET ON THE HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO FOOD PREP SURFACE.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: FOOD/DRINKING CONTAINERS REMOVED OR DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the COOK LINE TO BE COVERED BY A BAKING SHEET AND USED TO STORE EMPLOYEE FOOD AND DRINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the SERVICE AREA is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK AT THE SERVICE AREA TO BE BLOCKED BY MULTIPLE BOXES AND CONTAINERS, RENDERING IT INACCESSIBLE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLES OF WATER AND MULTIPLE SQUEEZE CONTAINERS UNLABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE LABEL ALL FOOD CONTAINERS WITH THE COMMON NAME OF THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED MANY SMALL FLIES IN THE COOKING AND STORAGE AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: OBSERVED A SINGLE USE EMPLOYEE GLOVE INSIDE OF A FOOD CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED MULTIPLE FOODS AND FOOD CONTAINERS STORED ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of SPICES AND POWDERS. OBSERVED VARIOUS FOODS STORED WITHIN REUSED SPICE CONTAINERS AND COFFEE CREAMER CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. UTILIZE NSF APPROVED OR THE EQUIVALENT CONTAINERS FOR FOOD STORAGE. CEASE REUSING MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion: OBSERVED WATER HELD IN A NON NSF APPROVED SPRAY BOTTLE.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. CDI: SPRAY BOTTLE DUMPED AND DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION. WING SHENG BAKERY (Inspection Date: 07/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility. OBSERVED CONSIDERABLE TRASH AND RECYCLABLES AROUND OUTDOOR DISPOSAL AREA.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. AREA MUST BE CLEANED AND KEPT CLEAN. CEASE HOLDING ITEMS OUTSIDE THAT ARE NOT NECESSARY FOR THE OPERATIONS OF THE FACILITY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD RESIDUE AND BUILDUP ON THE FLOOR OF ENTIRE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
